name: print-social-torn-graph-paper-portfolio-cover-with-black-letters
title: Portfolio cover on torn grid paper with taped corners and mismatched black-and-white letters
whatItIs: A black background with a torn sheet of squared paper held by lilac tape strips. The word PORTFOLIO is built from mismatched letters in black on white and white on black, with small doodle stickers (rainbow, smiley, flame, heart, sparkle) and a yellow '2024' pill and name tape.
whatItMeans: Handmade and collectable; torn paper and stickers feel like a scrapbook page.
techniques: Set a torn sheet with tape on a black field.
Mix serif, blackletter and rounded letters in black and white.
Use a yellow pill for the year.

vocabulary.definition: A ragged paper boundary used as a frame.
Translucent coloured tape holding paper down.
Letters from different styles in one word.
